subject: kair_blindsr

subject: llie_singleframe
note: single-frame low-light loader; fixed augmentation order and an explicit target-sharpening probability. Included to show which gates are inapplicable to a non-temporal pipeline (RQ4)

subject: basicsr_reds
note: BasicSR REDSDataset; the most widely reused video training loader in restoration. Included for reach, and as a concordance check against subject 1, which descends from it
